name: eight-months-of-silence-hard-constraints
description: Hard, checkable constraints referenced by agent/workflow.json phase ARCHITECTURE_CHECK and SELF_REVIEW. Intended to also back a CI lint step (Roslyn analyzer / custom script) over time — treat as the source of truth for that tooling.

rules.description: Domain assembly (EOS.Domain.asmdef) must not reference UnityEngine or any com.unity.* package.
Presentation code must not implement gameplay business rules directly (mission legality, puzzle-solution checks, evidence validity). It may only call Application services.
No circular references between Assembly Definitions.
Infrastructure implementations must be bound to an interface defined in Domain or Application at a VContainer composition root, never referenced directly by type from Presentation.
Forbid FindObjectOfType / FindObjectsOfType / GameObject.Find outside Editor-only tooling scripts.
Forbid new public static X Instance singleton fields holding mutable gameplay state.
Forbid legacy Input Manager calls; New Input System only.
Forbid empty catch blocks that swallow exceptions silently.
Forbid async void methods except recognized Unity event entry points (Start, Awake, OnEnable, OnClick handlers).
Forbid Resources.Load for new content; use Addressables.
MonoBehaviour files should not exceed ~200 lines or hold more than one clear responsibility. Flag for split if exceeded.
Any change to save-data serialization shape requires a docs/DECISIONS.md ADR entry describing migration/versioning.
Every new public method on a Domain or Application class must have at least one corresponding EditMode test.
Numeric/string literals used for gameplay tuning (damage, timers, thresholds) should come from a ScriptableObject asset, not be hardcoded in a class body.

MCP PLAY VERIFY: After any change to .cs/.prefab/.unity/.asset/InputActionAsset that touches gameplay mechanics or UI, agent MUST enter Play Mode via unity_unity_play_mode:play, execute the affected mechanic (e.g., PuzzleView panel, Inspection Hotspot examine, Inventory Take), and verify zero MissingComponentException/ArgumentException via unity_unity_console_log + unity_unity_get_compilation_errors (+ screenshot or unity_unity_execute_code for text mechanics). Claiming fixed without MCP play+execute fails this gate.
rules.enforcement: TEST phase via Unity MCP; DoD checklist item MCP PLAY VERIFY in AGENTS.md §7

rules.description: R1 Rujukan Wajib: Setiap keputusan desain/konten harus traceable ke file spesifik di docs/ (contoh: docs/03-core-gameplay-systems.md §Aturan Evidence). Laporan wajib cantumkan rujukan file.

R2 Larangan Fabrikasi Kanon: Dilarang mengarang fakta naratif, nama karakter, tanggal, angka gameplay final, atau keputusan desain yang belum ada di docs/. Gunakan placeholder eksplisit + tandai asumsi sementara.

R3 Pilar sebagai Filter: Sebelum desain sistem/level/konten baru, jawab eksplisit 3 filter — Grounded Horror Movement? Inspection sebagai Utama? Narrative Investigation via tindakan? Jika tidak, revisi.

R4 Scope Gate: Cek docs/10-production-scope.md sebelum implementasi. Fitur di 'Di Luar Scope Awal' (open world, multiplayer, procedural, skill tree, crafting kompleks, loot rarity, multiple ending, full voice) wajib eskalasi eksplisit.
R5 Anti Soft-Lock: Setiap sistem item/evidence/progres wajib cek docs/03-core-gameplay-systems.md aturan anti-frustrasi. Desain yang bisa soft-lock permanen harus ditolak atau diberi recovery path.
R6 Rating & Konten Sensitif: Deskripsi kekerasan/gore/luka/kematian harus implisit per docs/01-project-overview.md. Saat ragu, pilih framing tersirat + catat untuk review.
R7 Konsistensi Lintas Dokumen: Ubah/tambah topik harus cek dampak ke docs terkait (karakter Bab3 ↔ 04-narrative-and-characters.md). Jangan buat kontradiksi antar docs/*.md.
R8 Transparansi Batas Kemampuan: Jika task butuh keputusan gameplay/naratif milik game director/lead manusia, agent harus state eksplisit, bukan memutuskan sepihak.
TBD Diketahui: 9 item di docs/12-references-and-open-tbd.md tidak boleh diputuskan sepihak. Kerjakan bagian non-TBD, tandai output dengan <!-- TBD#N --> + 2-3 opsi, jangan hapus TBD dari docs/12.
TBD Baru: Jika gap desain ditemukan dan belum tercatat di docs/12, BERHENTI sebelum lanjut bagian yang bergantung. Jelaskan kebutuhan + opsi, tunggu arahan, lalu sarankan tambah ke docs/12.

enforcement.agent_self_check: Required at workflow phases ARCHITECTURE_CHECK (against the plan) and SELF_REVIEW (against the actual diff).
enforcement.ci_recommendation: Wire these patterns into a Roslyn analyzer or a pre-commit grep-based lint script (scripts/lint-rules.sh) so violations are caught even if an agent's self-check is skipped.
